name: Three Misses Confectionery
source:
On a rainy afternoon, a young man takes shelter in a cute and quiet confectionery. Three smiling chefs welcome him enthusiastically and offer irresistible cakes.

It seems like the perfect place to spend the rest of your life, doesn’t it?
